         Upgrade your V2 agent configurations to V3 with /upgrade-agent
                          https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/v3/
            Prefer the previous experience? Launch with kiro-cli --v2

      Tip: Made a wrong turn? Use /rewind to fork the conversation from any
      earlier point.

 ▸ Kiro CLI 3.0 launches at the end of October. If you have auto-updates on,
   you'll be upgraded to 3.0 automatically.
   It brings cloud sessions, memory, workflows, an improved trust model,
   expanded hooks and specs.
   Note: 3.0 doesn't support the legacy --classic experience or the legacy
   desktop app.
